Ranger Fusion unifies Sales, accounting, inventory, procurement, projects and HR into one next-generation ERP - built natively on Salesforce® Force.com Platform, with AI agents working across every module. Go live in 2-4 weeks, not months.

The problem

Growing businesses run on a patchwork. It is holding them back.

Every growing company reaches the same wall: too many tools, too little visibility, and an ERP decision that feels like a trap.

A patchwork of disconnected tools

Sales in Salesforce®, finance in one app, inventory in spreadsheets, HR somewhere else. Every handoff leaks time, data and money.

Legacy ERP cost & complexity

Traditional ERP projects run for months, demand heavy development and drain budgets before the business sees any value.

Scarce, expensive specialists

Finding skilled professionals to implement and support legacy ERP is hard - and keeping them is harder.

No single source of truth

When every department runs its own system, leaders can't see the full picture or act on reliable, real-time insight.

What is Ranger Fusion?

One system for the whole business - not seven tools glued together.

Ranger Fusion is a next-generation ERP developed by Procyon Technostructure and built natively on Salesforce® Force.com Platform. It brings Sales, accounting, inventory, procurement, project management, HR and Portals onto a single data model - with AI agents driving automation and insight across every module.

For a business leader, that means one login, one source of truth and one vendor relationship. For a technical team, it means enterprise-grade architecture on the platform the world already trusts - no brittle integrations to babysit.

  • Deep Sales-to-ERP integration on one platform
  • Unmatched flexibility for your specific processes
  • Rapid scalability for mid-market growth

Process automation and analytical insights come built in - not bolted on.

How Ranger Fusion works

From kickoff to a running ERP in four steps.

An agile implementation model that replaces the months-long legacy ERP project.

01

Map your processes

We sit with your teams to understand how sales, finance, inventory, procurement, projects and HR actually work - not how a manual says they should.

02

Configure on Force.com

Ranger Fusion is configured to your business on the Salesforce® Force.com Platform - highly flexible without heavy custom development.

03

Go live in 2-4 weeks

Agile implementation gets you from kickoff to a running ERP in weeks, with dedicated support and comprehensive training for your teams.

04

Scale with AI agents

Built-in AI agents work across every module - automating processes and surfacing analytical insights as your business grows.

Every implementation includes a dedicated support team and comprehensive training resources - so adoption sticks.

The Salesforce advantage

Why being built on Force.com changes everything.

Ranger Fusion does not integrate with Salesforce®. It is built on the same platform - and that architectural decision is the product's biggest strength.

One data model, Sales to ERP

Because Ranger Fusion is built natively on the Salesforce® Force.com Platform, your customer data and your operational data live in the same system. A quotation becomes an order, an invoice and a payment without an integration in sight.

Enterprise-grade trust & security

Your business runs on the same secure, trusted cloud platform that powers Salesforce® - with the data security and reliability enterprises expect.

AI agents built in, not bolted on

Ranger Fusion ships with AI agents that work across modules - driving process automation and analytical insights instead of adding another tool to manage.

Scales the way Salesforce® scales

Start with the modules you need today. Add users, functions and capabilities as you grow - future-proof for mid-market growth, without re-platforming.

Listed and top-rated on the Salesforce® AppExchange
Business outcomes

What changes when the business runs on one platform.

Ranger Fusion translates architecture into outcomes your CFO, COO and teams will actually feel.

Up to 20-60% cost savings

Consolidate the patchwork of accounting, HR, inventory and project tools into one platform - and stop paying for overlapping licenses and integrations.

Value in weeks, not years

A 2-4 week implementation means faster ROI. Your teams are productive before a legacy ERP would finish its planning phase.

Control on costing

Usage-based pricing and minimal development needs keep total cost of ownership low - and predictable.

Productivity your teams feel

A modern, intuitive interface and process automation remove the swivel-chair work between departments.

Data security by default

Your operational and customer data sits on the Salesforce® trusted platform - one system to secure, not ten.

Analytical insight on demand

One data model means reporting across sales, finance, stock and people without exports, VLOOKUPs or reconciliation.

Why Ranger Fusion

Four reasons enterprises choose Ranger Fusion over the old way.

01

Built on Salesforce®

Ranger Fusion runs natively on the Salesforce® Force.com Platform - the secure, trusted cloud that global enterprises already rely on.

02

Depth, flexibility and simplicity

Real ERP depth across seven business functions, configured to your specific needs, with an interface people actually enjoy using.

03

Disrupts legacy ERP models

Agile 2-4 week implementation replaces the months-long, consultant-heavy ERP projects growing businesses fear.

04

Scalable and future-proof

Purpose-built for mid-market growth - start lean, add modules and users as you scale, with AI agents working across the suite.

The honest comparison

Ranger Fusion vs the two roads businesses usually take.

Most growing companies either stitch together point tools or sign up for a legacy ERP project. There is a third option.

acceptedAnswer.text: Ranger Fusion is a next-generation ERP solution developed by Procyon Technostructure, built natively on the Salesforce® Force.com Platform with AI agents. It unifies Sales, accounting, inventory, procurement, project management, human resources and Portals into a single system for growing businesses.

mainEntity.name: Who is Ranger Fusion designed for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Growing and mid-market businesses that have outgrown a patchwork of disconnected tools - and want the depth of a real ERP without the cost, complexity and multi-month implementation of legacy ERP suites.

mainEntity.name: How does Ranger Fusion work with Salesforce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ranger Fusion is built on the Force.com Platform, so it runs natively inside the same trusted cloud as your Salesforce® CRM. Customer and operational data share one data model - a quotation flows into a sale order, invoice, payment and journal entry without integrations or re-entry.

A typical Ranger Fusion implementation goes live in 2-4 weeks, compared to the months a legacy ERP project usually requires. Every engagement includes a dedicated support team and comprehensive training resources.

mainEntity.name: How is Ranger Fusion different from other ERPs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three things: it is built on Salesforce®, so Sales and ERP share one data model; it combines real functional depth with a modern, intuitive experience; and it is highly customizable to your business with minimal development - which keeps total cost of ownership low and ROI fast.

mainEntity.name: How can we evaluate Ranger Fusion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Request a personalized demo and a Ranger Fusion product specialist will walk you through the modules that matter to your business, mapped to your processes. If you are attending Dreamforce 2026, you can also meet the team in person in San Francisco.
